verses.1: As fire burns from the depths of the waters, so will your name be known to those who need to hear it from you. Nations will tremble at your presence.
verses.2: In your deeds, you are wonderful. You have descended from before us; the mountains trembled at your presence.
verses.3: And from afar, they did not hear, they did not listen. They did not see God’s works in your land. He will make it a place of waiting for them.
verses.4: You have sinned against justice and righteousness in your ways. They will remember your sins forever. You were too proud, and you have sinned in them forever.
verses.5: And we became like filth and dirt; all our righteousness was covered with shame. We were destroyed completely, and our souls were taken away by the wind.
verses.6: And no one can read your name, nor can anyone claim to possess it, since you hid your face from them. They were left in the hands of our enemies.
verses.7: And now, Lord our Father, you are the wood that we are made from. You created us, and your hands have brought us into existence.
verses.8: Do not be too harsh with Yahweh, for He will never forget our suffering. Please remember the hardships that have befallen your people.
verses.9: The cities of your holiness were located in the Mediterranean Sea. Jerusalem was one of those cities.
verses.10: Our Holy House and our adornment, which our ancestors praised, will be burned with fire. And all our treasures will be destroyed.
verses.11: May Jehovah destroy these things; may He punish them and make them suffer until they are destroyed.
